name: MojiCode-Pro
description: Adds visual symbols to your coding experience for enhanced memorability and comprehension.

mojiCode.enabled.description: Enable or disable emoji keyword decorations.

enumDescriptions: Hide keyword text and show only the emoji.
Dim keyword text and show the emoji before it.
